name: Palace of Fine Arts
note: Maybeck 1915: octagonal domed rotunda in a lagoon, arcaded, deep sculpted attic under a low saucer dome, ringed by eight free-standing groups of four Corinthian columns carrying square sculpted boxes. The curved peristyle and the exhibition hall behind are separate OSM ways.

name: Conservatory of Flowers
note: 1878 white Victorian glasshouse, domed central pavilion over two barrel-vault-ish wings.

name: California Academy of Sciences
note: Renzo Piano 2008 (sf/cal-academy.ts): low glass box, the living roof of seven hills at 35 ft, the planetarium (E) and rainforest (W) mounds with porthole skylights, the piazza glass roof, the PV canopy on columns. front 318: the entrance faces the de Young across the Music Concourse.

name: Japanese Tea Garden Pagoda
note: tea-garden.ts: the five-storey pagoda (1915), vermilion and plaster under five flared dark roofs, gilt finial.

name: Japanese Tea Garden South Gate
note: tea-garden.ts: natural timber posts under two stacked tiled roofs.

name: Japanese Tea Garden Tea House
note: tea-garden.ts: open timber tea house on its deck under a big low grey roof.

name: Dutch Windmill
note: 1902 smock windmill at the park's ocean end: a pale cream-grey tower in one smooth taper (no steps), a thin dark gallery ring, a broad dark boat-profiled cap, four sails several times the tower's diameter crossed at the hub. Faces the ocean (owner 2026-10-06): the builder hangs its sails at local +z, which a numeric front places at the bearing + 180, so front 90 puts the cap and sails WEST, measured from the placed rotor. The sails turn (a rotor, render/rotors.ts).

name: Murphy Windmill
note: 1907 smock windmill, the larger of the two GG Park mills: same construction as the Dutch Windmill (tapering pale stucco, dark gallery, dark cap) but taller, with even longer sails relative to the tower.

name: Beach Chalet
note: 1925 Willis Polk, cream stucco, two storeys, red-brown hipped tile roof.

name: Spreckels Temple of Music
note: 1900 stone bandshell on the Music Concourse, colonnaded front, curved stone back wall.

name: Presidio Officers' Club
note: White Spanish colonial, arcaded front, red tile hip roof; oldest building in San Francisco (adobe core).

name: Japanese Tea Garden landscape
note: tea-garden-landscape.ts: the hero plants, rocks and water — cloud-pruned pines, the Mt Fuji and Dragon hedges with their bamboo, Waterfall Hill's dwarf trees and the waterfall, azalea domes, rocks and reeds round the ponds, the stream between them (positions: tea-garden-layout.ts, generated by tools/teagarden/layout.py). Not draped: each piece stands on the ground under it.
